# ADR-0002: Issue tracker

**Status:** accepted · **Date:** 2026-11-14 · generated by `new-project`; edit freely, it is yours now.

## Context

| Criterion | github | linear | jira |
|---|---|---|---|
| Fits | solo or code-centric; zero extra tools | small fast teams; keyboard-first; cycles | large orgs; heavy workflow customization |
| Agent access | gh CLI | MCP server and GraphQL | REST and MCP |
| PR linkage | closes #N | branch name or magic words | key in branch or title |
| Cost | included | free tier then per seat | free tier then per seat |

## Decision

**Decision:** github

## Consequences

Conventions in `docs/tracker.md`. The ticket key travels in the branch name and the PR title.

## Alternatives considered

linear, jira
